summary: Nexa Resources (NYSE: NEXA) filed a Form 6-K announcing that controlling shareholder Votorantim S.A. signed a definitive share-for-share exchange agreement with Boliden AB, selling Nexa shares for 0.250 Boliden common shares per Nexa share. Post-closing, Boliden will hold 64.68% of Nexa; Votorantim will hold ~7% of Boliden. Completion expected Q1 2027, conditional on shareholder and regulatory approvals, including Swedish FDI clearance. Concurrently, Boliden agreed to launch a cash voluntary tender offer for remaining Nexa shares at a price based on the exchange ratio and Boliden's 20-day VWAP, within 30 days of closing. A three-year standstill on further Nexa acquisitions requires independent committee consent. Watch for tender offer pricing and regulatory timeline.
